name: nav-signature
description: Nav's look: Anton display type on orange gradient posters, glass panels, mixed-typography captions (Inter ExtraBold + Instrument Serif italic accent), one accent colour, a prop for every line (Sahas-style pattern interrupts) on a blurred portrait background.

captions.rule: one accent word per phrase, the word that carries the meaning

pace.rule: every spoken claim gets a prop: a card, a word, a strip, a layer view. Never two full-screen takeovers back to back.

elements.hook: profile_card (name + what they did not do, red X slams on the key word) over the raw look, then switch_on
elements.poster: orange gradient, grain, Anton big word slams letter by letter, underline sweep, italic serif small line, Bebas sub line, no face cutout
elements.list: glass panel (dark, orange border glow), numbered, current item accent
elements.proof: board with lower:true (real screenshot as a card below the chin, captions shift up to y 1110); full-screen board only when the person is not speaking
elements.chips: white rounded, tilted, pop with overshoot, max 2 per beat
elements.behind: serif word behind the head, 280px, only when the head is low in frame
elements.cta: dark box hugging text, Bebas headline, accent button
elements.outro: dark card: COMMENT <word>, comment box types the word, heart + word reactions pop around it, brand line, skill name
elements.kinetic: one extruded Anton word per video, accent colour, slides in behind the head on the name of the thing (CLAUDE)
elements.filmstrip: strip of real source frames scrolling across the top + FRAME 0000/NNNN counter, for 'one raw take / every frame' lines
elements.exploded: the edit comes apart into layers (footage, captions, graphics) on dark, labelled, for 'every cut, caption, zoom' lines
elements.cut_timeline: video-only timeline, red removed regions labelled retake/um/dead air, struck-through transcript, for 'cuts the bad takes'
elements.phone_fan: your own videos fan out as phones (one real screenshot, the rest numbered), for 'give it your videos'
elements.silhouette: black cutout of the person on dark with orange glow + one Anton line, for 'like you' moments

broll.rule: only where no real footage exists and it adds meaning

never: other creators' faces in reference grids
a screenshot or card over the face while speaking: props sit below the chin, captions move up
graphics that make the viewer wait for the face: if a prop needs more than the lower third, make it a full-screen takeover of 3s or less

background.rule: no background blur by default: a textured set is part of the look. Blur (8 to 10px, from switch_on) only when the background is a plain or messy room.
